jobs.title: Account Development Representative
jobs.content: <p>An Account Development Representative at MongoDB is the starting point for building a serious career in technology sales</p><p>You will partner closely with Account Executives to identify new opportunities within strategic accounts</p><p>From day one, you will learn and apply structured sales frameworks including MEDDIC qualification, account mapping and value-based discovery</p><p>You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies</p>
